task_text.description: Short action statement grounded only in cited source messages. Candidate text, not confirmed fact.

activity_phrase_as_written.description: Exact activity cue from source, or null. Do not normalize into a known activity without review.

assigner_phrase_as_written.description: Exact name/mention in source, or null. No identity resolution.

assignee_phrases_as_written.description: Names/mentions as written. Empty when source does not clearly name an assignee.

deadline_phrase_as_written.description: Exact time/deadline wording, or null. Never convert relative wording into a calendar date here.

reviewer_scope_candidate.description: A review hint only. The user must confirm inclusion in their to-do view.

uncertainties.description: Missing context, ambiguous assignment, uncertain activity, unavailable media, or similar caveats.
